description: This file defines the Supervisor display field class used in reporting features of the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends a listable display field, specifies its associated DTO class, and provides methods to retrieve relevant fields and entity aliases.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: Represents the supervisor display field in report generation, specifying DTO class and relevant fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class associated with this display field, which is Supervisor DTO.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields related to the supervisor, specifically the employee number.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns entity aliases used in database queries related to this display field, here 'supervisor'.
